discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_5/cis_5.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_5/cis_5.1.x/cis_5.10.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: not win11cis_uninstall_ftpsvc_service); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.10 | PATCH | Ensure 'Microsoft FTP Service (FTPSVC)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_10
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.10
    - ftpsvc
  block:
    - name: "5.10 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Microsoft FTP Service (FTPSVC)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Check to see if FTPSVC service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: FTPSVC
      register: discovered_5_10_ftpsvc_service_info

    - name: "5.10 | PATCH | Ensure 'Microsoft FTP Service (FTPSVC)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Disable FTPSVC service"
      when:
        - discovered_5_10_ftpsvc_service_info.exists
        - not win11cis_uninstall_ftpsvc_service
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: FTPSVC
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped

    - name: "5.10 | PATCH | Ensure 'Microsoft FTP Service (FTPSVC)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Uninstall FTPSVC service"
      when:
        - discovered_5_10_ftpsvc_service_info.exists
        - win11cis_uninstall_ftpsvc_service
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: FTPSVC
        state: absent
